name: Coffee cherry, whole (ripe, as harvested)
source: Whole ripe Coffea cherry (skin + mucilage/pulp + parchment + bean): illustrative high-moisture proximate (per kg) water 650 g, protein 30 g, fat 20 g, carbohydrate 260 g, ash 40 g.
notes: Standard elemental conversion factors as wheat-grain.json. The cherry's bean fraction (roughly a fifth of fresh cherry mass — coffee-processing literature) is separated from skin/pulp/mucilage by a fixed real mass ratio (origin/coffee.ts), then washed and dried to coffee-bean-green's target moisture.
